Full 2024 operative 982,1956,2314,2315 and 1961 bodies are read. The pre-existing 1956(c)(7)(A) incorporates 1961(1), which already names 659 (if felonious) and 2314/2315; additions to(D) are not asserted as first-ever laundering predicates. Existing 1956 intent/knowledge, financial/jurisdictional requirements and distinct citizen/noncitizen extraterritorial conditions remain; no nationality/status is inferred from foreign commerce. Separate 982(a)(6) immigration/documentation forfeiture is not amended. Immutable 8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(43) context retains laundering funds exceeding $10,000, theft imprisonment thresholds and qualified fraud/deceit losses, not automatic consequences for every retail offense/person. Proposed center leadership by ICE/HSI, CBP and other staff, qualified confidential-information sharing, reports/training and seven-year-after-establishment sunset remain one package; agency names alone establish no domain fit. Canonical accepted 157 core/ref/digests remain authoritative and unchanged, with no replacement meaning. Keep unresolved/noncounting pending bounded Immigration application of materially changed offense definitions and complete referenced center/confidentiality framework; no automatic inclusion/exclusion or individual criminal/removal ruling. Own suspension-passage question precedes two-thirds voice ayes, Knott demand/order and postponement, followed later by 348-60 with 21 Not Voting. Foushee Nay and Massie Yea remain exact; Graves/Scholten hypothetical stated-for intentions are excluded.
